thread:
emily: opened a small PR to add a migration recipe for customers moving from shared pools to Dedicated reserved pools. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/511

raj: nice. can you include a short section on quota checks and the cost estimate formula? customers often skip that and hit surprises.

emily: added a 'cost-estimate' snippet and a bash one-liner to compute monthly GPU-hours. example: `echo \$((gpus * avg_hours_per_day * 30))`

tom: also add a note about billing cadence differences for committed capacity vs usage. important for finance teams.

emily: done. also expanded the autoscale examples to include a burst policy example for spiky traffic. uses a short-lived buffer pool + target_rps fallback.

raj: small feedback on the autoscale examples: the burst policy uses `scale_cooldown: 300` which is too long for bursty inference. recommend 60s.

emily: good call. changed to 60.

docs-bot: lint check: header style issue in the migration checklist (H3 expected).

emily: fixed headers. one outstanding: link-checker reports 404 on /platform/legacy-allocs.

raj: that link should be /dedicated/allocations. I can send a patch.

emily: patched link. also adding a small Go SDK snippet; customers asked for examples across languages. snippet: ```go
client := dedicated.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
op, err := client.CreatePool(ctx, dedicated.CreatePoolRequest{
  Name: "team-x-reserved",
  Region: "eu-west-1",
  MinGPUs: 1,
  MaxGPUs: 4,
  Autoscale: &dedicated.Autoscale{Mode: "request_rate", TargetRps: 800},
})
// poll op.ID for completion
```

tom: mention that the CreatePool call may require admin role in the private control plane. add IAM note.

emily: added IAM note and a link to the RBAC matrix.

raj: can we clarify the isolation section so it's explicit that isolation_tags are advisory for scheduling unless reserved_pool=true? a customer misinterpreted that last week.

emily: clarified: when `reserved_pool` is true it's strict isolation; otherwise tags are best-effort affinity. added YAML example and a one-line explanation.

docs-bot: link-check pass after /dedicated/allocations fix. spell-check flagged "autoscaleable" (typo).

emily: fixed typo. added CHANGELOG entry: "docs: migration recipe for shared -> reserved Dedicated pools; Go SDK snippet; autoscale burst example"

infra: quick question: in the Terraform snippet you reference `redwood_reserved_pool` resource. we should prefer `redwood_dedicated_pool` to match our public provider naming. also avoid exposing internal field `pool_internal_id`.

emily: swapped resource name and removed internal ID. updated snippet accordingly.

raj: LGTM from docs side. one more thought: add a short troubleshooting subsection for "stuck provisioning" with common causes (quota, subnet limits, image pull) and commands to surface status.

emily: added troubleshooting steps and a kubectl/status example.

docs-bot: all checks green. ready for merge.

emily: merging in 10. thanks everyone. :shipit:
